group-beeg-tax-swap.title: Tax Class & Assessment History
group-beeg-tax-swap.summary: Selects 12 eligible pre-birth months (skipping maternity/older-child exclusion months) and locks in the tax class held in the majority or tie-break of those months.
group-beeg-tax-swap.benefit: Planning a timely tax-class switch into Class III for the primary leave-taking parent can materially increase standardized Elterngeld net.
group-beeg-tax-swap.antiBenefit: Late switches do not rewrite the majority/tie rule, and Class V reduces the other spouse's monthly paycheck until annual filing.

group-muschg-maternity.title: Maternity Protection & Reference Pay
group-muschg-maternity.summary: Protects employment around birth and replaces 100% of the prior 3-month average net wage, credited against concurrent Elterngeld.
group-muschg-maternity.benefit: Preserves 100% net take-home pay during maternity protection and protects later BEEG lookbacks via exclusion months.
group-muschg-maternity.antiBenefit: Post-birth maternity weeks consume mother's Basiselterngeld months and enter annual § 32b tax progression.

group-beeg-synthetic-net.title: Standardized BEEG Net & Personal Plus Ceiling
group-beeg-synthetic-net.summary: Computes BEEG assessment net using flat social rates (9%/10%/2%) and January PAP taxes, independent of actual payroll take-home.
group-beeg-synthetic-net.benefit: High replacement up to 100% at lower incomes and 2-for-1 duration stretching under ElterngeldPlus.
group-beeg-synthetic-net.antiBenefit: Capped at €2,770 assessable net (€1,800 Basis / €900 Plus) with no social-contribution ceiling in flat deductions.

group-estg-tax-splitting.title: Annual Joint Assessment & Progression Settlement
group-estg-tax-splitting.summary: Reconciles monthly payroll withholdings against actual annual joint liability including splitting tariff and progression on replacement benefits.
group-estg-tax-splitting.benefit: Income splitting and deductions often generate substantial tax refunds when one partner has low/zero earnings.
group-estg-tax-splitting.antiBenefit: Elterngeld and maternity progression (§ 32b) frequently create year-end tax repayments when one spouse earns full salary.

group-beeg-partnership-bonus.title: Parent Claim Budgets & Partnership Bonus
group-beeg-partnership-bonus.summary: Coordinates individual/family Basis & Plus budgets (12+2 months) and unlocks 2–4 Partnership Bonus months when both parents work 24–32h/week.
group-beeg-partnership-bonus.benefit: Adds up to 4 extra ElterngeldPlus months per parent when sharing work and childcare symmetrically.
group-beeg-partnership-bonus.antiBenefit: Strict 24–32h corridor and minimum 2-month claim duration mean mistimed hours can forfeit bonus months.

group-beeg-sibling-bonus.title: Household Sibling Bonus (Geschwisterbonus)
group-beeg-sibling-bonus.summary: Grants a +10% supplement (minimum €75 Basis / €37.50 Plus) while qualifying older siblings remain under age 3 (or two under age 6).
group-beeg-sibling-bonus.benefit: Rewards closely spaced births with guaranteed minimum monthly additions.
group-beeg-sibling-bonus.antiBenefit: Expires immediately after the older sibling passes the age threshold and requires known sibling ages.

group-beeg-child2-dilution.title: Assessment Lookback for Later Births
group-beeg-child2-dilution.summary: Recomputes the 12-month assessment before each later birth, skipping maternity and eligible older-child Elterngeld months up to 14 life-months.
group-beeg-child2-dilution.benefit: Prevents older-child leave months (within 14 life-months) from depressing the next child's pre-birth average.
group-beeg-child2-dilution.antiBenefit: Part-time work or unpaid leave outside the 14-month exclusion window reduces the assessment base for the next child.

group-estg-kindergeld.title: Child Benefit & Tax-Allowance Favorability
group-estg-kindergeld.summary: Pays tax-free monthly Kindergeld per qualifying child and automatically tests annually whether Kinderfreibetrag yields greater tax relief.
group-estg-kindergeld.benefit: Guarantees monthly cash flow plus automatic optimization at higher marginal tax brackets.
group-estg-kindergeld.antiBenefit: You do not keep both full Kindergeld and full Kinderfreibetrag income-tax relief; § 31 nets them against each other.

group-estg-payroll-withholding.title: Monthly Payroll Withholding & Bonus Rules
group-estg-payroll-withholding.summary: Governs monthly wage tax, single-parent relief, Class IV factor, Solidarity Surcharge, and differential bonus withholding via BMF PAP.
group-estg-payroll-withholding.benefit: Accurate monthly cash flow modeling matching certified German payroll outputs.
group-estg-payroll-withholding.antiBenefit: Monthly withholding is only an advance payment; annual assessment determines final liability.

group-sgb-social-security.title: Social Security Contributions & Midijob Corridor
group-sgb-social-security.citationLabel: §§ 20, 23a SGB IV; § 241 SGB V; § 158 SGB VI; § 341 SGB III; §§ 55, 58 SGB XI; § 2 BVV
group-sgb-social-security.summary: Models statutory health, pension, unemployment, and care insurance contributions including Midijob relief, Saxony care rules, and cent rounding.
group-sgb-social-security.benefit: Captures Midijob contribution savings and multi-child long-term care discounts accurately.
group-sgb-social-security.antiBenefit: Childless employees aged 23+ pay a 0.6% surcharge, and Saxony employees pay an extra 0.5% base share.

group-aufenthg-blue-card.title: EU Blue Card, Opportunity Card & Permanent Settlement
group-aufenthg-blue-card.summary: Governs skilled worker salary floors, shortage/graduate exemptions, Opportunity Card points, and accelerated permanent residency.
group-aufenthg-blue-card.benefit: Enables 21- or 27-month permanent residence and streamlined spousal work rights when Blue Card thresholds are met.
group-aufenthg-blue-card.antiBenefit: Thresholds scale annually with statutory pension BBG limits and require careful salary verification at renewal.

group-estg-company-car.title: Company Car & Electric Mobility Taxation
group-estg-company-car.summary: Models imputed benefit-in-kind for private vehicle use (1% ICE, 0.5% PHEV, 0.25% EV up to €100,000) and commute distance surcharges.
group-estg-company-car.benefit: Pure electric vehicles within the €100,000 cap reduce monthly imputed taxable income by 75%.
group-estg-company-car.antiBenefit: Longer commutes add 0.03%/km monthly (quarter/halved for qualifying EVs/PHEVs) unless switched to actual-trip records.

group-estg-commuter-work-expenses.title: Commuter Allowance, Homeoffice & JobTicket Rules
group-estg-commuter-work-expenses.summary: Governs daily commuter distance deductions, Homeoffice flat-rate relief, the €1,230 employee lump sum, and tax-free employer transit subsidies.
group-estg-commuter-work-expenses.benefit: Combines tax-free employer transit benefits or excess Werbungskosten above €1,230 to reduce annual tax liability.
group-estg-commuter-work-expenses.antiBenefit: Tax-free § 3 Nr. 15 JobTicket subsidies reduce claimable commuter distance deductions euro for euro.

group-eeg-residential-solar.title: Residential Photovoltaic & Green Energy Incentives
group-eeg-residential-solar.summary: Combines 0% VAT purchase relief, full income tax exemption up to 30 kWp, and 20-year statutory EEG grid feed-in tariffs.
group-eeg-residential-solar.benefit: Zero VAT upfront plus tax-free self-consumption savings (~37 ct/kWh) and guaranteed 20-year feed-in income.
group-eeg-residential-solar.antiBenefit: EEG feed-in rates degress 1% semi-annually and export alone earns lower per-kWh returns than self-consumption.

group-housing-home-acquisition.title: Family Home Acquisition, KfW 300 & Closing Taxes
group-housing-home-acquisition.summary: Evaluates federal-state real estate transfer taxes, KfW 300 subsidized family loan limits by child count, and renovation craftsmanship tax credits.
group-housing-home-acquisition.benefit: KfW 300 provides up to €270,000 low-interest family loans while § 35a refunds up to €1,200/yr in renovation labor tax.
group-housing-home-acquisition.antiBenefit: Upfront closing taxes (3.5%–6.5% GrEStG + notary/agent) require liquid equity and KfW 300 tests prior-year zvE.
